title: Foundry
subtitle: Five verticals on one chassis, all build clean, zero env needed. The blockers are business calls: a blessed name, a domain, and a conversion path.

groups.name: 1 · The Name & The Domain (Critical Path)
groups.note: Nothing downstream moves until these calls.

items.what: Bless or replace the working brand name for the launch vertical
items.how: Recommendation: Journeyman first (only vertical with an unambiguously buyable domain today, and the MMS outbound lists already point at trades). Clear second as the PTG design-partner pilot, sold in a room rather than on a page.
Heads up: .cpa is a RESTRICTED TLD (verified accountancy credentials), so confirm plumb.cpa is even purchasable before committing to that name. .studio, .management and .trade are open.
items.label: porkbun.com → journeyman.trade

items.what: Decide vertical one's offer: the pilot price and what it includes, and approve the coded pricing tiers before /pricing goes public
items.how: The engine behind the demo is 0% built and the footer says so honestly. Price the pilot as a design-partner engagement, not a finished SaaS.

groups.name: 2 · Ship It (Fires The Moment Group 1 Exists)

items.what: All five verticals build clean: 8 static routes each, zero env vars, favicons, per-vertical metadata, honest seeded-demo disclosure in every footer
Create the GitHub repo under ModernMustardSeed and push master
items.how: No remote exists today; one clean commit on master.

items.what: Vercel project for the launch vertical (root apps/<vertical>) and bind the domain
items.how: Watch the known gotcha: vercel domains add binds to the CWD's project.

items.what: Add opengraph-image.tsx and metadataBase per vertical
Add sitemap.ts and robots.ts per vertical
Pick the conversion mechanism: form to Resend, calendar link, or a phone number
items.how: Right now a buyer literally cannot reach you from any of the five sites. Every CTA is internal navigation.

items.what: Build the chosen conversion path into the chassis so all five verticals get it at once
Wire the pilot payment path (Stripe checkout or invoice) once the number is set
Make the caps-fail-closed law real in code before anyone is billed
items.how: It is marketing copy today, not enforcement. Never-leak-revenue law: guards ship before money moves, or the claim gets softened.

items.what: Confirm the PTG design-partner path for Clear (the title vertical)
